feeds.title: Diabetes Care Community
feeds.description: Diabetes Care Community is privileged to have the following Canadian leading health care professionals write blogs for our community. These diabetes experts have been engaged for many years in helping people with diabetes lead healthier lives. Their blogs include ideas and advice for a healthy diet, self-management, medication and monitoring, physical activity and emotional support.

feeds.title: IDHC Blog
feeds.description: Facilitating community capacity-building, building upon traditional strengths and supporting community-driven programming has been a hallmark of the work of IDHC for the past 20 years. Our vision is that Indigenous people have the tools, knowledge and ability to make healthy choices and live free of all aspects of diabetes, now and future.

feeds.title: BC Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: We take pride in providing all the services of a traditional diabetes center. In addition, BCDiabetes offers a range of services, including telephone appointments with doctors, diabetes education by certified diabetes educators, nurse care, and dietician services. Our mission is to optimize care and improve treatment outcomes for every British Columbian living with diabetes

feeds.title: Buy Canadian Insulin Blog
feeds.description: Buy Canadian Insulin is a leading online prescription service dedicated to providing diabetes patients in the United States with low-cost insulin medication & diabetes supplies. We understand the importance that our patients receiving their insulin medication. That is why we take great care in making sure our customers are satisfied as believe customer support is a top priority.

feeds.title: DRIFCan News
feeds.description: The Diabetes Research Institute Foundation Canada (DRIFCan) was established in 2005 to fund the Edmonton Protocol. We are dedicated to funding research to find a cure for type 1 diabetes. We believe that donors supporting diabetes research want as much funding to go directly to cure-based research.

feeds.title: Beyond Diabetes Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lucy. I am a Registered Dietitian and Certified Diabetes Educator. If you find yourself frustrated by the nutrition needs of seemingly conflicting health demands, you are in the right place! Because managing 'just' diabetes can feel like a full-time job, add to that digestive issues, kidney disease, or cancer treatment knowing what to eat or managing blood sugar can feel impossible and I can help.

feeds.title: Connected in Motion
feeds.description: CIM creates a culture of support and engagement in diabetes self-management through experiential diabetes education and outdoor adventure pursuits. Their mission is to foster a community of people living with Type 1 diabetes through peer-based experiential diabetes education, sport and outdoor adventure pursuits so that they may inspire one another to live life without limits.

feeds.title: Dr Sue » Diabetes
feeds.description: I am a medical doctor, a Specialist in Endocrinology & Metabolism, and a diplomat of the American Board of Obesity Medicine. I am passionate, enthusiastic, and driven to help conquer the stigma against obesity; educate healthcare professionals and the public about obesity and diabetes, and help us become a healthier society!

feeds.title: Diabetes Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: We have been working for people living with diabetes since 2003. Our goal is to bring you together with the information and the individuals who can help you to improve your overall health with diabetes. Barb, the founder, has been active in the diabetes community for the past 22 years. As the diabetes goddess, she understands the highs and lows of living with this disease.

feeds.title: Diabetes Training 101 Blog
feeds.description: At Diabetes Training 101 Inc. we can help your practice with the tools and skills you need to help your patients become successful diabetes managers and take an active role in their own care. Michelle Archer has worked as a diabetes educator for over 15 years where she has witnessed how a person-centered approach makes a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes.

feeds.title: LMC Healthcare Blog
feeds.description: We're Canada's largest Specialist Care Provider in Diabetes & Endocrinology. We're dedicated to transforming diabetes specialist care, by making it more accessible, comprehensive and patient-centric than ever before. We strive to enable wellness by providing exceptional care and outstanding customer service to our patients, clients and communities.

feeds.title: Huron Perth Diabetes News
feeds.description: Our goal is to help people live well with diabetes. Explore our website to learn more about diabetes & the services we provide throughout Huron & Perth county. Whether diabetes is new to you or you have had diabetes for many years, our website will give you more specific information to help you manage your diabetes.

feeds.title: Wildly Fluctuating
feeds.description: Since Gretchen's diagnosis with type 2 diabetes in 1996, she has devoted much time to learning about this chronic disease and to using her background in both science and journalism to help educate fellow patients throughout the world so they can take control of their disease and avoid serious complications.

feeds.title: Sugar Smartz Blog
feeds.description: Sugar Smartz blog documents the lifestyle of Kevin Roulston, a teen with Type 1 Diabetes who writes about his diagnosis and treatment journey. Find insights about Diabetic healthcare, some personal stories and inspiration for other teens.

feeds.title: Breakthrough T1D Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1978, JDRF is the type 1 diabetes charity. We fund research to prevent, treat and cure type 1 diabetes and its complications, and we are the world's largest charitable funder of type 1 diabetes research. Our blog features recent research, tips for better health, treatments and more!
